crates/.purpose: run the Rust workspace test suite for the jankurai-guard crate

Cargo.toml.purpose: verify the workspace manifest builds with the locked dependency graph

Cargo.lock.purpose: verify the locked dependency graph resolves and stays consistent

rust-toolchain.toml.purpose: verify the pinned toolchain channel and components stay consistent

Justfile.purpose: verify the root command surface lanes are runnable

VERSION.purpose: verify the declared crate version stays coherent with release metadata

CHANGELOG.md.purpose: verify the changelog tracks released versions

README.md.purpose: verify the root readme routes to the workspace layout

LICENSE.purpose: verify the license file is present and unmodified

AGENTS.md.purpose: verify split-family agent routing remains present

.jeryu/.purpose: verify local Jeryu and GitHub mirror metadata

agent/.purpose: verify split control maps and standard metadata

schemas/.purpose: verify the guard output JSON schemas parse and stay coherent with the serialized types

tools/.purpose: verify the canonical security lane wrapper runs secret, dependency, SBOM, and workflow checks

.github/.purpose: verify CI workflow entrypoints stay pinned and thin

.gitignore.purpose: verify the exclusion list keeps transient build paths untracked

.gitleaksignore.purpose: scan secrets with exact historical documentation fingerprints
